δυσ-κρασία, ἡ, bad temperament, of the air, Str. 6.4.1 , Plu. Alex. 58 (pl.); σώματος Stoic. 3.216 ; τῶν ἐν ἡμῖν δυνάμεων Ph. 1.29 . ( δυσκρασίη Man. 4.543 .)

ψιμύθ-ιον (v. infr.), τό, = ψίμυθος , white lead, used as a pigment, esp. to whiten the skin of the face, Ar. Ec. 878 , 929 , Amips. 3 , Dialex. 2.6 , etc.; even for the hair, Pl. C.), POxy. 1088.4 (i A. D.), PLond. 3.928.21 , PMed.Strassb. p.4 (ii A. D.),
